stories.title: How to watch the 2026 National Dog Show this Thanksgiving
stories.summary: A holiday tradition for families across the nation returns for a 25th time on Thanksgiving Day on NBC, which has broadcast the event since 2002.

stories.title: Grand Illumination celebration to light Denver Union Station
stories.summary: Denver Union Station will begin the holiday season at 6:10 p.m. Friday with a lighting of the station’s 40-foot-tall Christmas tree featuring 7,000 lights.

stories.title: This Colorado star has been a symbol of hope for 90 years
stories.summary: Since the Great Depression, 100 bulbs have provided hope in Colorado during World War II, 9/11, the pandemic and the holiday season.

stories.title: 2 dead, 3 hospitalized after suspected drug overdoses
stories.summary: The victims ingested a narcotic laced with fentanyl, according to the Aurora Police Department.

stories.title: Search underway for missing Colorado hiker in area of 14,068-foot peak
stories.summary: The public is asked to stay out of the South Colony Basin and Humboldt Peak area, to allow rescue teams unimpeded access.

stories.title: 123-year-old former Colorado hotel damaged by fire
stories.summary: The historic Riverside Hotel in a Colorado mountain town burned down, leaving residents mourning a landmark. State and federal agencies are investigating the fire.

stories.title: Royal Gorge cancels holiday lights event
stories.summary: Royal Gorge Bridge cancels its annual holiday lights event due to park management changes, planning a return in 2027.

stories.title: 50 things to do in Colorado this Thanksgiving weekend
stories.summary: Colorado celebrates Thanksgiving and welcomes the holiday season with lightings, parades, "The Nutcracker" and "A Christmas Carol."

stories.title: AP investigation: The DEA allowed 1.4 million fentanyl pills to go unseized in major probe
stories.summary: Federal narcotics agents monitored a 2024 fentanyl deal at a New Mexico hotel but did not intervene.

stories.title: Denver enters top 3 for latest first snow amid Thanksgiving week warmth: Is snow in the forecast?
stories.summary: This Thanksgiving, Colorado experiences mild weather with a warming trend, but a weekend storm could bring snow to the mountains and cooler temps.

stories.title: Nuggets vs. Mavericks: How to watch the NBA Cup game on Tuesday
stories.summary: The Denver Nuggets face the Dallas Mavericks at Ball Arena in a nationally televised NBA Cup game Tuesday night on NBC.

stories.title: Nikola Jokić earns player of the week honor for 21st time
stories.summary: Since 1977, there have been 6 games with a triple-double of 37+ points and 18+ rebounds. Nikola Jokić has three of them.
